**Do you want to be at the forefront of protecting our society against cyber threats? We are looking for a Key account manager to our Commercial organization.

****About Truesec – A Leading Cybersecurity Company

**Since 2005, Truesec has been a native cybersecurity company, driven by one single purpose: Creating safety and sustainability in a digital world by preventing cyber breach and minimizing impact.

Over the years, we’ve earned the trust of organizations worldwide and gained a strong reputation internationally. Our team consists of dedicated specialists covering the entire spectrum of cybersecurity – with capabilities in Predict, Prevent, Protect, Respond, and Recover.

Today, we employ around 400 employees – and as cybercrime grows, we need to grow. To support that goal, we are now looking for a Key Account Manager who wants to make a difference.

**The Role

**At Truesec Denmark, we're on the lookout for an experienced Key Account Manager to drive our continued growth by winning new business and nurturing strong relationships with our great customers. As one of the primary points of contact, you will ensure our customers remain satisfied while we drive our business forward with high professionalism. You will cover customers in all of Denmark however the majority of your key accounts will be in Jutland. You will also:

• Create new business: Take the initiative and discover new opportunities to expand our customer portfolio. You will have freedom to set goals and initiatives that makes the Danish team perform even better than today.

• Build & retain relationships: Develop and maintain strong bonds with our customers, ensuring their needs are consistently met.

• Understand customer & market needs: Gain deep insights into our customers’ business goals and cybersecurity requirements in general.

• Drive growth: Identify chances to expand existing partnerships through upselling and cross-selling.

• Collaborate internally: Work closely with our teams to ensure we deliver solutions that exceed customer expectations.

• Monitor and report: Keep an eye on customer satisfaction, account performance, and market trends, and share your insights with the team.

• Stay informed: Keep up with the latest industry trends, emerging threats, and competitive developments to always offer the best advice.

**Your Potential Background

**To succeed in this role, we believe that you

• Bring extensive experience from the cybersecurity industry.

• Have a proven success as a Key Account Manager or in a similar client-facing role, ideally within the cybersecurity sector.

• Demonstrate exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, fostering strong connections with clients and stakeholders.

• Possess a proactive, results-oriented attitude and thrives in dynamic, fast-paced environments.

• Excel in organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities simultaneously.

• Have a track record of building and maintaining long-term, trusted client relationships.

• Tackles challenges with a solution-driven mindset and remains composed under pressure.

• Are proficient in CRM tools (preferably Hubspot) and skilled in using the Microsoft Office Suite.

• Exhibit business-level fluency in reading, writing, and speaking both Danish and English.

Due to the sensitivity in our assignments, we require Danish or Swedish citizenship or citizenship in an EU country.

**Join Our Mission Toward a Safe Digital Future

**If you truly want to make a difference and make our world a little bit safer, this is the place for you. At Truesec, you'll get to be at the forefront of fighting cybercrime instead of reading about it in the news. This is your chance to be part of an exciting journey in a leading cybersecurity company - and learn from some of the best in their field.

So, are you ready to team up with the most dedicated team of experts and be part of a meaningful mission? Then we are excited to get to know you!

**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

We are now hiring for an experienced Platform Engineer to join our Platform Engineering Team at our HQ in Islands Brygge.

Platform Engineers are an essential part of our technology foundation. You’ll be joining a team focused on empowering engineers by creating self-service infrastructure and tooling — “paved roads” that make the right path the easy path. You’ll work at the intersection of infrastructure and developer experience, contributing to our cloud architecture, Kubernetes operations, observability, and CI/CD.

****Role Overview

****As a Platform Engineer, you will build and maintain the core platform enabling our product squads to autonomously ship software securely and reliably. Your primary focus is on shaping our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes platform, developer tooling, and automated delivery pipelines so that our entire engineering community can move fast without breaking things.

You will join a multidisciplinary team spanning Network, Platform and SRE. While each team member deeply owns their primary craft, we operate with a highly collaborative mindset. We offer a supportive environment where you can not only continuously learn from domain specialists, but also make a direct impact on how we operate.

****What you’ll be doing

• Kubernetes Orchestration: Manage and optimize our Kubernetes platform, driving autoscaling, service resiliency, and efficient workload orchestration.

• Infrastructure as Code & Cloud: Design, build, and maintain secure, modular, and reusable cloud infrastructure using IaC to support global scalability and reliability.

• CI/CD & Delivery: Maintain and evolve CI/CD pipelines to ensure fast, consistent, and safe software delivery with high developer autonomy.

• Developer Experience & Self-Service: Create internal platform tooling, "paved path" workflows, and self-service infrastructure to reduce developer friction and promote engineering best practices.

• Observability & Reliability: Evolve metrics, logging. Eventually participate in an on-call rotation to ensure high availability and swift incident response.

• Security & Governance: Balance ease of use with compliance, security and efficiency.

****What you bring

****We firmly believe that skills are transferable. Not familiar with this stack? Have experience with another one? That works!

• 
Team work makes the dream work. You have worked in small to medium sized platform teams.

• 
Strong experience managing production workloads on Kubernetes.

• 
Hands-on proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform, OpenTofu, Crossplane...).

• 
Practical experience building automated CI/CD pipelines and self-service platforms for software developers.

• 
Experience with cloud fundamentals (we run on AWS) and security practices.

• 
Experience in observability platforms using modern tools (we currently run Grafana Cloud) for metrics, logs, and traces.

• 
Familiarity participating in on-call rotations and driving post-incident reliability improvements (not a requirement).

• 
Bonus Points:

• 
Experience operating a platform NOT using Kubernetes.

• 
Experience in TelCo.

****Don't check every box? Apply anyway.

****We care more about curiosity, strong fundamentals, and an eagerness to learn than ticking off every single requirement. If you are passionate about building great platform tooling and keen to grow alongside a supportive team, we’d love to hear from you.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

That means:

• We don’t need your picture or cover letter - just your CV

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

**We’re fast but thoughtful - our goal is to ensure you feel informed, respected, and excited throughout the journey.

**

• 30-minute screening call with our recruiting team.

• Hiring Manager (in-person) with Baptiste (Engineering Manager)

• Technical interview with one or more of our engineers, your future peers

• Final stage - Meet with our CTO, Henrik Aagaard

****Ready to Make an Impact?

****Send us your application, and let’s start the conversation.

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

The translational pharmacology research group at Clinical Pharmacology, Pharmacy and Environmental Medicine (CPPEM), Department of Public Health, Faculty of Health Sciences, University of Southern Denmark, invites applications for a fully funded 18 months postdoctoral position. The position is to be filled from January 1st, 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter.

About the Research Environment

The research areas of CPPEM span from pharmacoepidemiology to clinical studies, and cell-based basic pharmacology and environmental medicine. Collectively, CPPEM has a strong background in exposure to environmental chemicals, pharmacoepidemiology, pharmacogenetics, pharmacokinetics, drug-drug interactions, and therapeutic drug monitoring. Specifically, the translational pharmacology group aims to understand variability in drug toxicity, drug metabolism and drug transport. Examples of this include cell-based models such as induced-pluripotent stem cells, primary human hepatocytes, and clinical studies. The pharmacoepidemiological research group utilizes the world-class Danish registries as well as international data sources to assess pharmacological questions in large populations. The environmental medicine group studies the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. In particular PFAS is a focus area, with studies of the adverse health effects of exposure, biomonitoring and advising national and international authorities. The analytical chemistry laboratory analyzes concentrations of drugs or environmental chemicals in various matrices. 

In the Environmental Medicine group we are looking for a post doc funded by Novo Nordic Foundation and ERC advanced grant. The projects focus on the Odense Child Cohort and study the impact of early life exposures to environmental chemicals. Especially PFAS and their adverse effects on maternal and child health (e.g. the brain, immune, metabolic and reproductive system). In addition, we aim to identify toxicity of short PFAS including trifluoroacetic acid, widely used but considered less toxic due to their short half-life. 

We are seeking a candidate with a PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline. Work within environmental medicine is an advance, and epidemiological and statistical skills are essential. Motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to excel in environmental research are very important. Excellent communication skills in written and spoken English is a requirement. The position includes independent scientific writing, clinical project leading, and supervision of students. You should be interested in contributing both to the scientific armamentarium in our department and to our collegial culture. It is also expected that the post doc contributes to additional fundraising for the projects as well as research collaborations and the continuation of the Odense Child Cohort, and takes on teaching responsibilities within the department. You will, in your daily work, refer to Professor Tina Kold Jensen, but also engage in a very active collaboration with the full research group.

Your qualifications

• 
PhD in medicine, pharmacology, public health, or a related discipline.

• 
Experience within environmental medicine is considered an advantage

• 
Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English

• 
Ability to work independently with scientific writing and publication

• 
Interest in and experience with supervision of students

• 
Commitment to contributing to both scientific excellence and a positive collegial culture within the department

• 
Interest in establishing and maintaining national and international research collaboration
 

Further information

Interviews can be performed online if needed. If you will need to relocate to Denmark for the position, both the University and the research group will provide ample support.

Additional information about the position can be obtained from Tina Kold Jensen (tkjensen@health.sdu.dk; 0045 29464350).

Salary and terms of employment

The successful applicant will be employed in accordance with the agreement between the Ministry of Finance and AC (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations).

Application

Applications must be submitted electronically using the link "Apply now".

We strongly recommend that you read How to apply for a position at SDU before you apply.

The application must include (as PDF files) (please note that the application (the motivation letter) and CV must not exceed 10 MB in total):

• 
a motivational letter

• 
a detailed CV

• 
degree certificates (including documentation of Master’s and PhD degree) 

• 
a complete and numbered list of publications

• 
Up to 3 scientific peer-reviewed publications considered by the candidate as most important for this position. 

• 
a teaching portfolio detailing the candidate’s prior teaching experience, teaching skills, and teaching philosophy

• 
a description of research experience

For technical issues, please contact: hcm-support@sdu.dk 

Please note that all the above-mentioned information must be included in the application.  

Applications received after the deadline and/or incomplete applications will not be considered. 

Application deadline

November 4, 2026, at 23.59 hrs. (CET).

Assessment

Shortlisting will be used as part of the initial selection process. 

Assessment of shortlisted applications will be done under the existing Appointment Order for universities. Shortlisted applications will be assessed by an assessment committee. The committee may request additional information, and, if so, it is the responsibility of the applicant to provide the necessary material. 

When the assessment committee has submitted its report, the applicants will receive part of the evaluation that concerns themselves. 

References will be obtained for the preferred candidate from their current and previous employers. Applicants invited for interview should expect to complete a work-related personality assessment.

Living and working in Denmark 

Foreign applicants will be offered Danish language training as part of the employment.

**About Us

**You know that rental bike you unlocked with your phone this morning? Or the tracker on your dog's collar that tells you he's two streets away, again? Neither of those works without a network connection. Onomondo is the layer that makes sure the data actually gets through.

We're the infrastructure behind the Internet of Things (IoT). Companies building connected products come to us for the connectivity that keeps their devices online, anywhere in the world, and for the platform where they manage, monitor, and troubleshoot it themselves.

****Where we sit

****We're somewhere between SaaS and telecom. We sell software, so we move fast, ship often, and care about the user experience. But we also operate inside telecommunications: which is more complex and technical than most software. Our customers are engineers, they ask hard questions and the relationship starts rather than ends at purchase.

That mix also makes us sticky. Most SaaS tools are nice to have. If our connectivity stops, our customers' products stop. That means our business grows as our customers and the industry grows. We've been growing fast and we don't plan to slow down, which is exactly why we need this role.

****Why this role exists

****Our rapid growth has outpaced our ability to guide people through it manually. We have a free trial program that could convert a little better, referral partners who could be onboarded and activated at scale, and happy customers that would gladly write reviews if we asked them at the right time.

Today most of that is handled ad hoc, by a person, or not at all. This role exists to (re-)design the programs, to make them scalable and implement the improvements.

You'll report to our Head of Growth Marketing, and you'll be the first person to own Lifecycle end to end.

****What you'll do

• Design and run the journeys new users go through, from free trial signup through onboarding and activation

• Improve our email nurture strategy and content to make it scalable, modular and reusable across different segments

• Build the onboarding and activation motion for referral partners, at scale, without manual handholding

• Build the communication journeys that give customers control of their own onboarding, changes, and troubleshooting

• Turn product usage signals into timely and triggered communication, from adoption nudges to advocacy asks

• Work across Marketing, Customer Success, Sales, and Product to agree on the trigger points, handoffs, and what happens after

Not all at once, of course. We'll start with what matters most, build it to scale, then keep going.

****What we're looking for

****A programs manager with a commercial head. Someone who thinks in buyer journeys rather than individual campaigns, and who understands what actually moves a deal or an account forward.

Crucially, someone who can both design and implement. You'll sketch the journey and then go build it together with a Growth Operations Specialist.

• Around 4-6 years in a marketing or commercial operations role, ideally in B2B or SaaS

• Hands-on in HubSpot or a comparable platform (segmentation, reporting, emails)

• A strong writer who can shift tone between a developer on a free trial and a distributor's commercial lead

• Comfortable working across functions and stakeholders, and confident enough to push for the handoff you need

• Keen on documentation so a journey you designed can be extended by someone who wasn't in the room

• Curious about how things work. You don't need to know what a SIM does today, but you should want to find out

****Life at Onomondo

****The things we build have global reach. The way we build them is personal. We're a team of engineers, operators, and commercial minds in Copenhagen who debate passionately about technical or GTM approaches and then go for a run together. Or padel. Or a beer. Or a boardgame night. People here stay curious, speak up when something feels off, and bring energy whether it's a product launch sprint or a Friday bar.

Practically speaking, that looks like: full health insurance, catered cooked-on-site lunch every day, an in-office gym with HIIT and yoga three times a week during work hours (we're serious about this), quarterly Friday bars, an espresso machine, a full snack and drink-bar and a pretty impressive breakfast setup.

****Applying

****Your application doesn't need to be polished. What we'd like to hear about is the programs and motions you've designed before: free trial flows, distributor or partner onboarding, referral motions, email nurture programs, anything in that family. Tell us what you built, what you were trying to move, and what happened.

****Our hiring process

****We care deeply about creating a fair and inclusive process.

**That means:

**

• We don’t need your picture

• We select candidates based on skills and relevant work experience for the role.

**What you can expect:

**

• Screening call with Emelie, Head of Growth Marketing (Online, 30 minutes)

• Skill interview with Emelie and Connor, our Head of Brand Comms (In-Person, 1 hour)

• Meet with our CCO Jillian and Co-Founder, Michael (In-Person, 30 minutes)

Note - We review and interview candidates continually, and therefore encourage you to apply at your earliest convenience.

At 3Shape we improve treatment and diagnostics for dental patients through innovative software and 3D scanners for dental professionals worldwide. A quarter of our staff work in R&D.

Your role

Our scanners have to work the same way in thousands of dental clinics as they do on an optical bench in Copenhagen. This role bridges the gap from optical concepts to solutions that can be manufactured, calibrated, verified, and released. You will join the optics team in R&D and own the optical subsystem in one or more scanner development projects at a time. Depending on the project, this means designing it yourself, or defining specifications for a development partner to build, then verifying the result. Finally, you will be responsible that the optical subsystem will work in the product.

Much of the work takes place where design meets real-world implementation: what tolerance mechanics can eventually hold, what a supplier can deliver at volume and at cost, what calibration needs from the optics, and what to do when the measurement disagrees with the model. You will work in a multidisciplinary team of mechanical, electronics, embedded software and test engineers alongside production engineering, quality and regulatory colleagues. Success in this role depends on your ability to collaborate effectively across these functions.

Day to day you will:

• Design, model and dimension optical imaging and illumination systems

• Specify optical components and modules for production by external partners

• Build and measure prototypes, interpret and act on measured results

• Run tolerance analyses in collaboration with mechanical engineers, and communicate evidence-based recommendations

• Work with software and electronics engineers on calibration and image quality

• Collaborate with optics suppliers and development partners, from feasibility through qualification

• Write the specifications, analyses and verification evidence a medical device requires

Within the optics team, early concept work and lifecycle support of our released scanners fall under the responsibility of other colleagues. This role covers the stretch in between — the projects on their way to becoming products. Technical direction is set together with our principal and senior engineers, so you will have experienced sparring partners close at hand.

Your profile

We care considerably more about how you work than about which degree you hold. The engineer we are looking for:

• Gets satisfaction from things that ship and keep working

• Decides with incomplete information, and takes it well when a measurement later proves the decision wrong

• Treats cost, tolerances, manufacturability and regulatory requirements as part of the design problem

• Works out optical requirements together with mechanical and electronics engineers

• Writes clearly, because in a medical device the documentation is part of the product

• Knows when an optical system is good enough, and balances technical perfection with project needs and timelines

Background we expect:

• A degree in engineering physics, photonics, optical engineering, physics or a comparable field — B.Sc., M.Sc., or equivalent competence built on the job

• A few years developing physical products that successfully transferred to manufacturing, which we value as highly as years of optics experience on their own

• Solid optical fundamentals: geometrical optics, radiometry, image quality and tolerancing

• Able to model and interrogate an optical design in a ray tracing tool — enough to lay out a system yourself, and enough to challenge a design someone else produced

• Strong on measurement and lab work: building and aligning setups, characterizing externally supplied subsystems to judge whether they meet specifications

• Scripting for analysis and data handling (Python, MATLAB or similar)

The role is based at our Copenhagen office. Prototypes, test setups, and the colleagues you will daily interact with are on site, so this is predominantly on-site work, with the option of one day a week remote. Travel is limited, typically a handful of days per year to suppliers and to our production site in Poland.

We offer

In 3Shape R&D we are proud of our diverse, ambitious and highly skilled colleagues. Working for 3Shape means joining one of the most successful MedTech companies and making a real impact. We offer:

• A chance to impact the treatments of millions of dental patients, globally

• Innovative technology in a true R&D focused company, with room to stay at the edge of what is possible

• Empowerment and entrepreneurial thinking: we believe the best results are achieved by empowering our people and teams

• Sparring, coaching, feedback and a personal development plan to sharpen your toolbox

• Highly skilled and motivated colleagues in an international atmosphere (30+ nationalities in our building)

• An attractive and informal work environment in downtown Copenhagen, with a good work/life balance, breakfast every day, lunch cooked by our own chefs, and many optional social clubs

Read more about us at https://careers.3shape.com/#vacancies

We encourage all relevant applicants to apply. We are committed to celebrating human diversity, and we trust that the best way to reach outstanding business results, is by welcoming diverse people into our community.

About us

3Shape started with a simple idea - to make 3D scanning better. First, we applied it to the hearing industry, then we succeeded in dentistry. Twenty years later, 3Shape has 2,000+ employees globally. With the help of dental professionals and amazing colleagues we’re creating award-winning scanning and CAD/CAM solutions to change dentistry together! Together, we contribute to a better world. Experience the everyday #lifeat3Shape across the globe on LinkedIn.

Are you passionate about working at the interface between medical devices and pharmaceuticals? Do you have significant experience navigating medical device quality requirements?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior QA Medical Device Specialist.

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

At our headquarters in Hellerup, Denmark, research facilities in Heidelberg, Germany, and additional offices across Europe and the United States, we are advancing programs in our Endocrinology Rare Disease and Oncology portfolios. We also collaborate with partners on the development of TransCon-based products in other therapeutic areas and markets.

We are seeking a passionate Senior QA Medical Device Specialist to join our growing team. As a key member of the Ascendis Pharma team, you will play a crucial role providing quality oversight across the lifecycle of medical devices and drug-device combination products while acting as a trusted quality partner to development, manufacturing, regulatory, commercial, and external stakeholders. Working at the interface between medical devices and pharmaceuticals, you will help translate regulatory requirements into pragmatic and compliant quality solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment, collaborate with cross-functional, global teams working together to achieve extraordinary results.

You will be joining the QA Medical Device team consisting of 3 colleagues, and report directly to Cecilie Bengtsen, Director of QA Medical Devicewho is based in Hellerup, Denmark_._ You will also be based in Hellerup, Denmark.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Provide quality oversight of medical device and drug-device combination product activities throughout the product lifecycle.

• Support development projects through design control activities, risk management, design reviews, design transfer, and maintenance of technical documentation.

• Drive and support continuous improvement of the Quality Management System and implementation of evolving regulatory requirements.

• Provide quality support for product release, deviations, CAPAs, change controls, inspections, and post-market activities.

• Act as a trusted QA business partner to cross-functional stakeholders by facilitating risk-based decision making and ensuring appropriate quality governance.

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a relevant academic degree – preferably a master’s degree in engineering, pharmacy, biotechnology, life sciences, or a related scientific discipline – and min 7 years of experience within the life science industry.

Furthermore, you have:

• Extensive experience with MDR, ISO 13485, FDA 21 CFR Part 820, and ISO 14971.

• Preferably experience with drug-device combination products, including 21 CFR Part 4 and ISO 11608.

• Hands-on experience within Quality Assurance and medical device development, including design controls.

• Experience supporting audits, inspections, supplier quality activities, and quality system processes.

• Professional proficiency in written and spoken English.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to be:

• Confident in interpreting regulatory requirements and translating them into operational practice.

• Effective at building relationships and influencing stakeholders across development, manufacturing, quality, and regulatory functions.

• Pragmatic, adaptable, and solution-oriented, with the ability to balance compliance, quality, and business objectives.

Travel: 1-5 days per year.

Office: Ascendis Pharma A/S, Tuborg Boulevard 12, Hellerup, Denmark

Are you passionate about life science and want your legal expertise to support innovation from early development through clinical trials to commercial product supply? Do you have experience within drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts that directly support innovation and scientific advancement?

If so, now is your chance to join Ascendis Pharma as our new Senior Legal Counsel (R&D).

Ascendis Pharma is a global biopharmaceutical company committed to making a meaningful difference in patients’ lives. Guided by our core values of Patients, Science, and Passion, we are applying our innovative TransCon® technology platform to fulfill our mission of developing new therapies that demonstrate best-in-class potential to address unmet medical needs.

You will be joining the R&D Legal team currently consisting of 5 colleagues, and report directly to Sara Weiss, Head of R&D Legal,who is based in Hellerup, Copenhagen_._ You will also be based in Hellerup, Copenhagen.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Act as a key legal partner to Product Supply and Quality, supporting agreements such as commercial supply and manufacturing-related contracts, and advising on legal matters arising in day-to-day supply chain operations.

• Draft, review, and negotiate a broad range of other contracts, including confidentiality, service, consultancy, research, license, collaboration, and material transfer agreements.

• Provide legal and contract support to other departments within the R&D organization, including Research, Medical Affairs, and Regulatory Affairs — based on your experience and interests.

• Actively contribute to a collaborative team culture within the R&D Legal team.

Qualifications and Skills:

You hold a Master’s degree in Law and bring at least 7–8 years of experience as an in-house legal counsel or as an attorney in a law firm, preferably within the pharmaceutical or life sciences sector.

Furthermore, you have:

• Proven expertise in drafting, reviewing, and negotiating a wide range of complex contracts in the pharma industry.

• Solid experience supporting Product Supply and Quality, including drafting and negotiating commercial supply and manufacturing agreements.

• Experience supporting Chemistry, Manufacturing and Controls (CMC), including agreements with CMOs/CDMOs for CMC development and manufacturing activities, is an advantage.

• Experience with clinical trial agreements, including negotiating trial site agreements, vendor contracts (e.g., with CROs), and reviewing informed consent forms is an advantage.

• Strong understanding of intellectual property law, including the handling of IP rights in contractual contexts.

Key competencies:

You are a strong team player, analytical, and have a can-do attitude.

You possess an entrepreneurial mindset and can thrive in an informal, open environment where innovation and change are key.

To succeed in this role, we also expect you to have:

• Business-oriented legal mindset – You are able to translate complex legal concepts into practical guidance that supports scientific and operational decision-making in a fast-paced R&D environment.

• Stakeholder collaboration – You work proactively and effectively with cross-functional teams, including scientists, project managers, and external partners, to align legal strategy with research goals.

• Risk assessment and mitigation – You can identify potential legal risks early in the development process and propose balanced solutions that enable innovation while ensuring compliance.

We are looking for a skilled and curious electronics engineer with an interest in developing electronics and software solutions for various interesting research and development projects in the intersection between optics and electronics. 

We work on both fundamental and very applied research and development projects in close collaboration with both academic and industrial partners. These projects often involve many interdisciplinary competences. 

The job
You will be an important part of our research and development projects with responsibility for the development of innovative but still robust electronics and software solutions. You will support our researchers in optics and photovoltaics by ensuring high-quality solutions. The job includes a high freedom to experiment and select the most appropriate methods.

Our expectations of you
We expect you to be electronics engineer or have a similar academic relevant background.

Experience in the following is an advantage:

• Analog and digital electronics design.
• PCB layout
• FPGA programming
• Programming in LabVIEW
• Programming in C, MatLab, Python
We expect you to be open-minded, solution-oriented and take ownership of your work. It is important that you contribute actively to projects with ideas and thrive in an environment where development happens through close collaboration and technical discussions with interdisciplinary colleagues.

What we offer in return
We offer an interesting and challenging job in an international environment with the focus on research, teaching, innovation and scientific advice for the benefit of the surrounding community. Through our research and development projects you will have the chance to contribute to the state-of-the-art research and development of solutions for our collaborating companies. A job with a high degree of freedom but also high expectations. The Technical University of Denmark is a leading technical university in Europe, and you can contribute to making us even stronger.

The position is a full-time position. Starting date is 1 January 2027 (or as soon as possible).

Application and contact
Please submit your online application no later than 2 November 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Open the “Apply now” link, fill out the form and attach your motivated application, CV and exam certificates. 

If you would like additional information about the position, please contact Senior Researcher, Ole Bjarlin Jensen, +45 4677 4553, ojen@dtu.dk, or Senior Electronics Engineer, Henning Engelbrecht Larsen on + 45 2367 5099, heel@dtu.dk.

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

DTU Electro 
DTU Electro employs more than 300 skilled researchers with competencies in electrical and photonics engineering. As a department we strive towards creating sustainable energy and a greener internet, as well as strengthening cyber security and health technology. Working with the industry and public organizations is one of our top priorities to find and implement new solutions to our society. We aim to offer education, research, and innovation of the highest standard, and our focus on application-oriented research enables us to work across many engineering disciplines and research areas, such as IT and the medical and health sciences. We have a close collaboration with researchers from all over the world, just as we collaborate with industry and public authorities about the dissemination of solutions based on electrical and photonics engineering as their key enabling technologies.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

**The Impact You'll Make

**As our new Senior Mechanical Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping the next generation of nozzles, pumps, and spray solutions used in cooling, heating, humidification, snowmaking, and other critical applications. You will take ownership of mechanical product design and development, helping to ensure our solutions remain innovative, competitive and compliant while delivering value to customers around the world.

Your work will directly support Danfoss' position as a global leader in key components and technologies that help improve energy efficiency, enable sustainable heating and cooling, and contribute to responsible water usage. Through innovation, optimisation and close collaboration across the business, you will help create solutions that make a meaningful difference for our customers and society.

While Danfoss offers the scale and opportunities of a global technology leader, our Spray and Burner Technologies business combines those advantages with the agility of a smaller, highly independent organisation. Here, your ideas can quickly become reality, your contributions are highly visible, and your development is a priority. Whether you aspire to become a recognised technical expert or grow into a leadership role, you'll find strong support, meaningful responsibility, and clear opportunities to shape your career.

**What You’ll Be Doing

**In this role, you will take technical ownership of mechanical products and drive development activities from concept through implementation. One of the unique aspects of this position is the opportunity to work with full product responsibility throughout the entire product lifecycle.

Because our organisation combines the advantages of a global engineering business with the agility of a smaller, independent business unit, you'll gain exposure to every part of the value chain. This will allow you to broaden your technical and commercial understanding, develop your skills across multiple disciplines, and build close working relationships with colleagues across the organisation while seeing the direct impact of your decisions.

• Act as the technical owner of assigned products, ensuring performance, quality, compliance, innovation and cost competitiveness

• Lead the design and development of new mechanical solutions and products for emerging applications

• Drive product optimisation initiatives and continuous improvement activities across the portfolio

• Validate and implement design changes through testing, analysis and collaboration with key stakeholders

• Partner closely with Sales, Product Management, Manufacturing, Procurement, Quality, Logistics, suppliers and customers to deliver successful product outcomes

**What We're Looking For

**We're looking for an experienced mechanical engineering professional who enjoys taking ownership, solving complex technical challenges, and collaborating across disciplines to create innovative products.

**Essential Qualifications

**

• Several years' experience in mechanical product design and development, ideally within manufacturing or industrial product environments

• Strong experience designing mechanical components and systems from concept through validation and implementation

• Proficiency with 3D CAD tools such as Inventor or similar design software

• Experience working with product compliance requirements and relevant standards such as UL, TÜV, CE, or similar

• Strong communication skills in English and a collaborative approach to working across functions and cultures

**Preferred Qualifications

**Experience with mechatronics, mechanical product design, simulation tools, AI-supported engineering methods, or product optimisation techniques would be considered an advantage.

**Work model

**This role requires close collaboration with colleagues, production, laboratories and key stakeholders on-site. Therefore, we are looking for someone who can work from our Nordborg location on a daily basis and enjoys being close to both the products and the people who bring them to life.

**What You'll Get From Us

**You'll join a highly experienced and collaborative team with a strong, family-like culture built on openness, trust and mutual support. Our organisation brings together development, production, assembly and testing capabilities in one location, giving you a unique opportunity to understand the complete product lifecycle and make a visible impact on the business.

You'll help engineer a better future by contributing to solutions that make a real difference around the world.

We'll support your career growth with mentoring, learning opportunities, and access to global career paths.

You'll have the flexibility, autonomy, and support you need to do your best work while maintaining a healthy work-life balance.

You'll be part of an inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds are respected, valued, and empowered to succeed.

You'll receive a competitive rewards package that includes benefits such as an annual bonus, paid vacation, pension plans, health insurance, and more. As a global company, these benefits vary by country and contract.

**Ready to Make a Difference?

**If you're an experienced mechanical design engineer who enjoys technical ownership, innovation, and turning ideas into high-performing products, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now to start the conversation and learn more about where your career can go with us.

**What Makes Us, Us

**Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!

At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — caring, customer success-driven, collaborative, curious, and courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.

**WHY THIS ROLE IS IMPORTANT TO US

**The Senior Contract Management Specialist / Senior Contract Counsel (CM) is a key role in the Contract Management team, which is part of Legal & Compliance. The CM supports all SimCorp offerings, including on-premises, SaaS, Professional Services and BPaaS. The CM is responsible for drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing various contracts with clients, as well as providing legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters. The CM also ensures that the contracts are compliant with the law and the business objectives, and that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework.

The CM works closely with the Legal team, Customer Success Management, Service Delivery Management, Project Management Office, and other internal stakeholders to understand the business and technical requirements, and to align the contracts with the best practices and standards of SimCorp. The CM also collaborates with Client Services to monitor and optimize the commercial performance and quality of the contracts.

**What You Will Be Responsible For

**The CM is involved in the entire contract lifecycle, from the pre-contractual phase and support to Customer Success Management, to the onboarding project, to the contract change management, to the obligation management and quality assurance, to the exit handling.

The CM also manages and maintains together with the team the contract repository and the contractual database and supports the further implementation of contract management processes and relevant tools within SimCorp, including the upcoming Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) Platform.

The CM will be part of a self-organizing and cross-functional team that delivers value to the clients and the business.

As a CM, some of the daily or weekly tasks that you can expect are:

• Drafting, reviewing, negotiating, and executing client contracts, and ensuring that they are aligned with the legal, commercial and technical requirements

• Business partnering through legal advice and guidance on contract and commercial matters, and resolving contract-related issues and disputes

• Supporting the Customer Success Management, the Service Delivery Managers, the Project Managers, and other internal stakeholders with contract and legal interpretations

• Monitoring and optimizing the commercial performance and quality of the contracts, and collaborating with the business on commercial management

• Supporting the obligation management and quality assurance process, and ensuring that SimCorp performs its obligations under the Contract Assurance & Performance framework

• Supporting the exit handling process, and assisting with drafting termination notices and handling contractual obligations related to the exit strategy

• Participating in weekly status meetings

• Learning and developing new skills and competencies related to contract management and legal matters

**What We Value

**

• A law degree or a relevant degree in contract management, contract administration, or business administration, with a focus on commercial law

• 5+ years of experience in contract management, contract administration, or as a legal counsel, preferably in the SaaS, Outsourcing or IT industry

• Knowledge of contract and commercial law, as well as the legal and regulatory aspects of SaaS and cloud services

• Knowledge of Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) is an advantage

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, Co-Pilot/Claude, and in contract management software and tools

• Fluency in English, both written and spoken

• Experience working in a collaborative team that values teamwork, humor, and good communication

• The CM is expected to have solid communication and presentation skills, as well as solid analytical and problem-solving abilities. The CM should be able to work on their own initiative and as part of a team, and to handle multiple tasks and projects in a fast-paced and demanding environment. The CM should also have a high level of professionalism and integrity, and a customer-oriented and self-starter mindset

**Benefits

**Attractive salary is essential for any work agreement. However, in SimCorp we believe we can offer more. Therefore, in addition to the traditional benefit scheme, we provide a good work-life balance: flexible working hours and a hybrid model. Simcorp follows a global hybrid policy, asking employees to work from the office two days each week while allowing remote work on other days.

Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photo, age, or any non-professional information from your application. We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.

Driving projects independently and managing senior stakeholders

Influencing decisions on cyber and information security at some of Denmark's leading companies and public institutions

Programming and deploying your own agentic software tools

**ARE YOU READY TO SHAPE HOW GANNI COMES TO LIFE ACROSS EVERY PHYSICAL CUSTOMER TOUCHPOINT? WE ARE LOOKING FOR A COMMERCIAL, CREATIVE, AND HANDS-ON LEADER TO DRIVE OUR GLOBAL VISUAL MERCHANDISING STRATEGY.

****Your Mission & Responsibilities Ahead Of You

**As Head of Global Visual Merchandising, you will play a key role in bringing the GANNI brand to life across our global retail network. Acting as the bridge between Creative and Commercial, you will translate seasonal creative direction into visual merchandising concepts that strengthen the customer experience, support commercial performance, and ensure a consistent brand representation across all physical customer touchpoints.

Working closely with Creative, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Marketing, and Product teams, you will develop global visual merchandising standards while supporting markets in delivering best-in-class execution. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution - project management, stakeholder collaboration, and continuous improvement.

**Responsibilities ahead of you:

**Global Visual Merchandising Strategy

• Develop and continuously evolve GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy across all physical customer touchpoints.

• Translate seasonal creative direction into commercially effective visual merchandising concepts and execution.

• Act as the bridge between Creative and Commercial to ensure visual merchandising aligns with both brand identity and commercial priorities.

• Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure consistent execution across the business.

Brand Representation & Customer Experience

• Develop global VM guidelines, seasonal playbooks, execution decks, and visual standards.

• Ensure consistent brand representation across Retail stores, Wholesale, Department Stores, Concessions, Showrooms, Pop-ups, and Events.

• Lead the visual merchandising direction for seasonal launches, campaigns, collaborations, and key commercial moments.

• Ensure VM standards are executed consistently across all markets while allowing relevant local adaptations.

• Create engaging customer experiences that support both the brand and commercial objectives.

Commercial Performance

• Partner closely with Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, and Marketing to maximise commercial performance through visual merchandising.

• Use retail KPIs and commercial insights to continuously improve customer experience and sales performance.

• Support product sell-through through effective product presentation, storytelling, customer flow, and merchandising principles.

• Monitor store feedback and customer behaviour to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.

Global VM Community & Capability

• Support and develop GANNI's global network of field Visual Merchandising resources and Retail VM Ambassadors.

• Develop training programmes, tools, and best practices that strengthen VM capabilities across markets.

• Coach regional VM resources and retail teams to ensure consistent execution.

• Foster collaboration, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning across the global VM community.

**Showrooms & Physical Brand Experience

**

• Lead the visual merchandising strategy across global showrooms during seasonal sell-in periods.

• Ensure collections are presented in a commercially effective, inspiring, and customer-focused way.

Cross-Functional Projects

• Lead global VM projects from concept through implementation.

• Support new store openings, refurbishments, showroom projects, retail concepts, and pop-up activations.

• Collaborate closely with Creative, Marketing, Retail, Wholesale, Buying, Merchandising, Product Development, and Retail Operations.

• Continuously identify opportunities to simplify VM processes and improve ways of working across markets.

**Must Have Requirements

**

• 5–8 years of experience within Visual Merchandising in fashion, lifestyle, or premium retail.

• Experience developing and implementing visual merchandising strategies across multiple markets and sales channels.

• Strong understanding of how visual merchandising influences customer behaviour, supports commercial performance, and creates a consistent customer experience.

• Experience creating global VM guidelines, seasonal toolkits, showroom concepts, and visual standards.

• Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work across Creative and Commercial functions.

• Excellent project management and organisational skills.

• Strong communication and presentation skills.

• Fluent in English.

• Willingness to travel internationally.

**THE GANNI WAY

**We're looking for someone who combines creativity with commercial understanding and enjoys working across functions to bring ideas to life.

You are a hands-on leader who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys turning creative concepts into clear, practical solutions. You build strong relationships, communicate with confidence, and naturally collaborate across teams and markets.

You have a curious mindset, continuously look for opportunities to improve, and understand how strong visual merchandising can strengthen both the customer experience and business performance.

We are looking for a true GANNI ambassador - someone who shares our values of Openness (ready to evolve, honest not perfect), Optimism (you never stand still, just dance!), Authenticity (you march at your own beat!), Accountability (no excuses, you make an impact) & Responsibility (make small changes, see big differences).

The GANNI culture is based on a learning and results-driven mentality, where everyone is united by a common purpose of (hack)the fashion system!

GANNI is a state of mind - more than a way of dressing and we love to change the usual practice in everything we do. We are confident and capable of anything! So prepare yourself to be comfortable with the uncomfortable and hacking the system together with our amazing VM team!

**WHAT ELSE?

**

• Based in Copenhagen.

• Global role with regular international travel.

• Opportunity to shape the future of GANNI's global visual merchandising strategy and execution across Retail, Wholesale, Showrooms, and other physical customer touchpoints.

• Lead and develop a global VM team while working closely with colleagues across Creative and Commercial functions.

**DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION

**At GANNI, we are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone feels valued, respected, and empowered to thrive. We actively encourage applications from people of all backgrounds - regardless of gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, racial identity, religious belief, disability status, or personal expression.

We believe that diversity drives creativity and innovation, and we are dedicated to building a team that reflects the world around us.

To support unbiased hiring, we kindly ask you not to include your photo, age, or marital status in your CV - we’re only interested in why you’re a great fit for the role.

**BE BOLD AND JOIN OUR GANNI COMMUNITY!

**We hope you got all your questions answered and feel motivated to join our team and become a part of the GANNI community.

We will be interviewing candidates continuously and kindly ask you to send your application and CV as soon as possible. Please use the “Apply for position” button.

**MORE GANNI GOODIES

**You will be working out of our unique GANNI house located in the beautiful City Center of Copenhagen on top of the Bremerholm flagship store. Besides our amazing and colorful new office facilities, we are also proud of our inhouse GANNI kitchen that offers healthy and sustainable food cooked by our passionate in-house chef.

Intro

Karo Healthcare, a dynamic and growing personal-care retail company, is all about making smart choices for everyday healthcare. With a wide-ranging portfolio across seven categories, including medical products, we own and sell over 80 brands in about 90 countries. Our portfolio includes such brands as E45, Pevaryl, Lamisil, Nutravita, Decubal, and many others. Our core belief in empowering people to make intelligent health decisions drives our growth strategy, blending organic expansion and M&A.

Join us at Karo Healthcare on our exciting journey. We're currently looking for a Key Account Manager, Pharmacy for our office in Copenhagen.

What’s in it for you?

This is a high-impact commercial role where you will take real ownership of key pharmacy partnerships, influence how our brands win in-store, and work closely with Sales, Marketing, E-commerce and external partners. You’ll join a fast-moving international business where ideas turn into action quickly and where there is plenty of room to shape the role, grow your commercial expertise and make a visible impact.

What you’ll be doing

• Develop and execute customer strategies for key pharmacy accounts together with the Sales Director, Brand Managers and E-commerce KAM.

• Plan, submit, execute and evaluate trade campaigns together with internal teams and external agencies.

• Build, strengthen and grow strategic relationships with existing pharmacy partners.

• Lead annual customer planning, commercial negotiations and account development.

• Identify commercial opportunities that drive sustainable growth, profitability and sell-out performance.

• Ensure customer campaigns, pricing, assortment, product information and commercial activities are implemented accurately and on time.

• Act as a commercial sparring partner to Brand Managers to create best-in-class brand visibility and in-store execution.

• Manage key wholesaler processes, including maintenance of pricing, assortment and customer information.

• Take ownership of the CRM system supporting pharmacy sales representatives and help ensure effective commercial execution of key pharmacy accounts

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior RF / Microwave Hardware Engineer to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s RF and microwave design capability.

You will design and develop RF and microwave hardware and subsystems, including receiver front ends, amplification, filtering, mixers and local-oscillator circuitry, RF signal routing, and PCB- and module-level implementation. The work covers RF performance analysis and design trade-offs, circuit architecture, schematic design, component selection, circuit and electromagnetic simulation, RF PCB implementation and layout, prototyping, debugging, and performance validation.

You will work closely with system architects, antenna systems engineers, SDR and signal processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, and partner engineering teams. The role requires deep RF and microwave design expertise, technical ownership, and hands-on implementation experience, taking designs from concept through prototyping and validation to documented, manufacturable RF modules and subsystems.

Key responsibilities

• Translate system requirements into RF hardware architecture, specifications, performance budgets, and design trade-offs.

• Design RF and microwave circuits, modules, and signal-acquisition paths, including amplification, filtering, switching, mixing, frequency synthesis, gain control, and supporting bias, power, and control circuitry.

• Perform RF performance analysis covering sensitivity, selectivity, gain, noise figure, dynamic range, linearity, stability, spurious responses, and interference resilience.

• Create RF schematics, select components, and own RF PCB implementation, including laminate and material selection, stack-up definition, and layout, with controlled-impedance routing, transmission lines, grounding, shielding, isolation, and high-frequency interconnects.

• Perform circuit and electromagnetic simulations, optimize designs, and correlate simulated performance with laboratory measurements.

• Lead prototypes bring-up, tuning, debugging, and design verification in collaboration with RF test and characterization engineers.

• Integrate RF hardware with antenna systems, data-conversion interfaces, mechanical assemblies, and platform interfaces.

• Contribute to design verification, EMC/EMI assessment, environmental qualification, reliability evaluation, and system-level validation.

• Prepare hardware specifications, design documentation, BOMs, analysis reports, design-review materials, test inputs, and production-release documentation.

• Own technical decisions related to component and supplier selection, manufacturability, testability, lifecycle risks, and design-risk mitigation.

• Collaborate with system, antenna, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

Required qualifications and experience

• Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, RF/microwave engineering, applied physics, or a related field. A PhD is an advantage.

• 7+ years of professional experience in RF and microwave hardware design.

• Strong hands-on experience developing RF circuits, multilayer PCBs, modules, and subsystems from schematic design and simulation through layout, bring-up, tuning, and validation.

• Experience with receiver architectures and RF signal paths, including low-noise and gain stages, filters, switches, mixers, oscillators, PLL-based frequency synthesis, and supporting bias, power, and control circuitry.

• Strong understanding of RF system budgeting, chain analysis, and frequency planning, including gain, noise figure, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, P1dB, IP3, phase noise, stability, spurious responses, isolation, and impedance matching.

• Practical experience with RF PCB implementation, including laminate and material selection, stack-up definition, controlled-impedance routing, transmission lines, grounding, shielding, isolation, and high-frequency interconnects.

• Hands-on experience with schematic capture and RF PCB layout using an industry standard ECAD tool such as Altium Designer, Cadence Allegro/OrCAD, or equivalent.

• Proficiency with one or more RF circuit and electromagnetic simulation tools, such as Keysight ADS, Cadence AWR Microwave Office, Ansys HFSS, or CST Studio Suite.

• Hands-on experience with RF measurement equipment, including vector network analyzers, spectrum analyzers, signal generators, and oscilloscopes.

• Demonstrated ability to bring up, tune, troubleshoot, and validate RF hardware and correlate measured results with simulations.

• Experience taking RF hardware through prototype manufacturing, assembly, design verification, environmental requirements and qualification, and production release.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based radio architecture.

• Experience designing wideband, high-dynamic-range, low-noise receiver systems.

• Experience with coherent or multichannel RF systems, including channel matching, phase stability, and synchronization.

• Experience developing aerospace, mission-critical, or ruggedized electronic systems.

• Experience developing RF and microwave hardware operating at frequencies up to and beyond 18GHz.

Success in the first 6 months

• Take technical ownership of one or more RF modules or subsystem areas.

• Establish the initial architecture, design approach, and development plan for the assigned RF scope.

• Deliver reviewed schematics, simulations, layout inputs, and supporting design documentation.

• Bring up and validate initial hardware prototypes, with clear correlation between expected and measured performance.

• Identify key RF, implementation, and integration risks and define practical mitigation actions.

• Establish effective technical interfaces with system, antenna, signal-processing, test, mechanical, manufacturing, and partner engineering teams.

At Claimlane, we're looking for a problem solving focused Product Designer. You'll spend most of your time talking directly to customers to understand how they work through their problems today, then shape and validate the right solution with the team and finally design the solution. This is a problem-solving role first, design second.

You will enjoy this role if you are curious, work fast, and appreciate the opportunity to have a huge impact on our product.

About Claimlane

Claimlane is a rapidly growing B2B SaaS scale-up. We fix complex claims and returns processes for top retailers and brands like Matas, Coolshop, Black Diamond, and Tonies.

We're looking for A-players who want to make a difference and grow with the business. We value a strong positive attitude, a high sense of ownership, and long-term thinking. Attitude beats talent.

We want to build a billion-dollar business, and part of that is building a team with billion-dollar potential.

The Role

You will spend the majority of your time solving problems, not producing designs & screens. That process starts with talking directly to customers and the team, mapping out how customers work through a problem today, and building a clear, written definition of how to build a better solution for them. Only once the problem is deeply understood do you shape a solution, and even then, you validate it with real customer feedback before treating it as done and ready to be designed.

You will work in close collaboration with product and engineering from day one, and you will rapidly take on more independence as you build context. Within your first month, you will be solving smaller problems on your own. Within three months, you will independently own problem definition and design for solutions end to end.

This is a junior-to-mid-level role built for fast growth. You do not need years of product design experience, but you do need to be an exceptional problem solver who is comfortable getting close to customers, curious about how things actually work, and eager to grow into a stronger product designer along the way.

Key Responsibilities

• Talk directly to customers and the team to deeply understand problems and map them out.

• Turn ambiguous problems into clear, written problem definitions before shaping a solution.

• Design and ship solutions for working closely with engineering & customer facing team.

• Run customer and user-testing conversations and turn findings into concrete product improvements or new solutions.

• Gather feedback on shipped work and use it to shape the next iteration.

• Take on progressively larger and more ambiguous problems as you build context and trust with product and engineering.

Requirements

• Exceptional problem solver who structures ambiguous situations into a clear definition before jumping to a solution.

• Comfortable talking directly to customers and mapping out their workflows to understand a problem from the ground up.

• Strong visual and UX sense, able to turn a well-understood problem into clean, modern, and readable designs.

• Clear communicator who can explain design decisions and trade-offs in handoffs to engineering, including edge cases.

• Quick learner who picks up new tools, product domains, and feedback fast.

• Balances speed and quality, knowing when good enough is the right call to keep the team moving.

• Low-ego, high-energy collaborator who works transparently and takes feedback well.

Bonus Points If You Have Experience With

• Running customer interviews or user research independently.

• Working directly with engineers on technical constraints and trade-offs.

• Working in B2B SaaS or scale-up environment.

• Figma and modern design tooling.

Location and Compensation

Our office is in Nørrebro, Copenhagen, and this is an in-office role. Our team enjoys coming in, and everyone has the flexibility to shape their workday around their lifestyle.

Our compensation package is competitive, and we offer an attractive warrants and stock program.

If you're a positive, ambitious person who wants to build real problem-solving muscle as a product designer, Claimlane will be the right vehicle for you, and we'd love to welcome you. Don't waste time, apply now! 🚀

Hiring Process

• Intro Call: A 15 to 30 minute conversation to see if we click.

• Culture Interview: A 1 to 2 hour deep dive into values, mindset, and team fit.

• Problem-Solving Case: A 1 to 3 hour session working through a real customer problem, from understanding it to proposing a solution. No polished mockups required. We're flexible if you prefer another format, so feel free to shine in your own way.

• Team Meetup: A 30 minute chance to say hi to the team.

• References: A final check before we make things official.

Apply on LinkedIn or send your resume to asl@claimlane.com. We review candidates on an ongoing basis. Sending a 60 second video introducing yourself will move you to the top of the stack, though it's not required.
